item.title: Communion Hymn
Great Litany
item.description:
Lord, have mercy

Lord, have mercy

To Thee, O Lord

Amen

item.title: First Antiphon
item.description:
Bless the Lord, O my soul. Blessed are You, O Lord!

Bless the Lord, O my soul. And all that is within me, bless His holy name!

Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits;

Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases.

The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.

Bless the Lord, O my soul. And all that is within me, bless His holy name!

item.title: Second Antiphon
item.description:
Amen. Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

Praise the Lord, O my soul!

I will praise the Lord as long as I live;

I will sing praises to my God while I have being.

Put not your trust in princes, in sons of men in whom there is no salvation.

When his breath departs he returns to his earth;

on that very day his plans perish.

item.title: Hymn of Incarnation
item.description:
Only-begotten Son and immortal Word of God,

Who for our salvation willed to be incarnate

of the holy Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary,

who without change became man and was crucified,

O Christ our God, trampling down death by death.

Thou art one of the Holy Trinity,

glorified with the Father and the Holy Spirit.

Save us!

item.title: Third Antiphon
item.description:
In Your kingdom remember us O Lord when Thou comest in Thy kingdom.

Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.

Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.

Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

item.title: Entrance Hymn
item.description:
Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ;

O Son of God Who didst rise from the dead save us who chant unto Thee: Alleluia.

item.title: Trisagion Hymn
item.description:
Holy God! Holy Mighty! Holy Immortal! Have mercy on us. (3x)

Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

Holy Immortal! Have mercy on us.

Holy God! Holy Mighty! Holy Immortal! Have mercy on us.

item.title: Gospel Response
item.description:
And to your spirit

Glory to You, O Lord, Glory to You!

item.title: Litany of Fervent Supplication
item.description:
Lord, have mercy

Lord, have mercy

Lord, have mercy. Lord, have mercy. Lord, have mercy

item.title: Cherubic Hymn
item.description:
Let us who mystically represent the cherubim,

and who sing the thrice-holy hymn to the life-creating Trinity,

now lay aside all earthly cares.

Amen.

That we may receive the King of all,

Who comes invisibly upborne by the angelic hosts.

Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

item.title: Litany of Supplication
item.description:
Lord, have mercy.

Grant it, O Lord.

To Thee, O Lord.

item.title: Anaphora
item.description:
A mercy of peace, a sacrifice of praise!

And with your spirit

We lift them up unto the Lord

It is meet and right

To worship the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit

The Trinity One in essence and undivided

Holy! Holy! Holy! Lord of Sabaoth!

Heaven and earth are full of Your glory!

Hosanna in the highest!

Blessed is He Who comes in the Name of the Lord!

item.title: Hymn to the Theotokos
item.description:
It is truly meet to bless thee, O Theotokos,

ever-blessed and the most pure, and the Mother of our God.

More honorable than the cherubim, and more glorious beyond compare than the seraphim:

without defilement thou gavest birth to God the Word:

true Theotokos, we magnify thee.

item.title: Communion Hymn
item.description:
Praise the Lord from the Heavens

Praise Him in the Highest

Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth

And their words unto the ends of the world

Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

item.title: Lord's Prayer
item.description:
Our Father, Who art in heaven,

hallowed be Thy name.

Thy kingdom come.

Thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

Give us this day our daily bread,

and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us.

And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.

item.title: Liturgy Ending
item.description:
“We have seen the true Light”

We have seen the true Light!

We have received the heavenly spirit!

We have found the true faith!

Worshipping the undivided Trinity, who has saved us.

Amen.

Let our mouths be filled with Thy praise, O Lord,

that we may sing of Thy glory;

for Thou hast counted us worthy to partake of Thy holy, divine, immortal, and life-creating Mysteries.

item.title: Agni Parthene
item.description:
1. O virgin pure, Immaculate lady Theotokus

    Agní Parthéne Déspina, Áhrante Theotóke,

  2. Rejoice, O unwedded bride

    Hére Nímfi Anímfefte.

  3. O Virgin Mother, Queen of all/ and fleece which is all dewy

    Parthéne Mítir Ánassa, Panéndrose te póke.

  4. Rejoice, O unwedded bride

    Hére Nímfi Anímfefte.

  5. More radiant than the rays of sun/ and higher than the heavens

    Ipsilotéra Uranón, aktínon lamprotéra,

  6. Rejoice, O unwedded bride

    Hére Nímfi Anímfefte.

  7. Delight of virgin choruses/ superior to Angels.
